Daily Quiz.question: ১) The house <u>ablaze</u> is next door to him. Here, ablaze means-
Daily Quiz.exp: Ablaze (adj)- জলন্ত; Burning (adj)- জলন্ত।

Daily Quiz.question: ২) One who conceals his identity as a writer under an assumed pen-name.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Pseudonym(noun): a name that someone uses instead of his or her real name, esp. on a written work:
Samuel Clemens used the pseudonym Mark Twain.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Which one is the correct spelling?
Daily Quiz.exp: Efflorescence: the period when flowers start to appear on a plant.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) The branch of medical science which deals with the problems of the old-
Daily Quiz.exp: Geriatrics: a branch of medicine that deals with the problems and diseases of old age and the medical care and treatment of aging people.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Choose the antonym of the word HAGGLE.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Haggle- তর্কাতর্কি করা।
outright- সরাসরি, কোন রকমের বিতর্ক ছাড়া।

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) One who plays game for pleasure and not professionally-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Amateur- অপেশাদার।
Connoisseur- রসপণ্ডিত।

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) The sentence ‘Hardly a day goes by without thinking of her’ means-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I think of her when absolutely necessary
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) It is impossible to think of her almost everyday
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I do not think of her almost everyday
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I think of her almost every day
Daily Quiz.exp: Hardly a day goes by​/​passes without something (doing something)- used for saying that something happens almost every day.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) ‘To taunt’ someone means to -
Daily Quiz.exp: To taunt- provoke or challenge (someone) with insulting remarks.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) A ‘cartographer’ makes-
Daily Quiz.exp: Cartographer (noun): a person who draws or produces maps.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) One whose attitude is : 'eat, drink and be merry'.
Daily Quiz.exp:
One word substitute is Epicurean.
Epicurean: a person devoted to sensual enjoyment, especially that derived from fine food and drink.
Cynic: a person who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest rather than acting for honourable or unselfish reasons.
Materialistic: excessively concerned with material possessions; money-oriented.
Stoic: a person who can endure pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) ‘Philatelist’ means a-
Daily Quiz.exp: Philatelist(noun): a person who collects or studies stamps.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Silo : Corn
Daily Quiz.exp: শস্য (Corn) রাখার জন্য ব্যবহার করা হয় সাইলো (Silo) এবং পানি (Water) রাখার জন্য ব্যবহার করা হয় জলাধার (Reservoir)।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Philology is the -
Daily Quiz.exp: Philology is the study of language in written historical sources; it is a combination of literary criticism, history, and linguistics.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Which word is closest in meaning to <u>abettor</u>?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Abettor (noun): a person who encourages or assists someone to do something wrong, in particular to commit a crime.
Conspirator(noun): a person who takes part in a conspiracy.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) What is the synonym of ‘Effigy’?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Effigy- প্রতিকৃতি;
Dummy: কোনো ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর নকল যা আসল ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর উপস্থিতির উদ্দেশ্য সিদ্ধ করে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) The word ‘imbecile’ means-
Daily Quiz.exp: Imbecile (noun): a stupid person.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) The opposite of ‘Nebulous’-
Daily Quiz.exp: Nebulous- অস্পষ্ট, Vague- অস্পষ্ট, indistinct- অস্পষ্ট।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Select the correctly spelt word.
Daily Quiz.exp: Arbitrariness- স্বেচ্ছাচার।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) The noun form of ‘persuade’ is -
Daily Quiz.exp: Persuade(verb): প্ররোচিত করা; Persuasion (noun): প্ররোচনা।

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Carlos tries to be ________. (help)
Daily Quiz.exp: Helpful- সহায়ক, উপকারী।
